[CR CR1435 for 38.423] Reason for change: The agreed R3-240947 (38.423 CR1226r1) implemented onto TS 38.423 v18.1.0 wrongly placed the S-CPAC Request IE description of the S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message in 8.3.4.3 “Unsuccessful Operation”. Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release). This CR only has an impact on Rel-18 Intra-SN S-CPAC. Consequences if not approved: The S-CPAC Request IE description is not aligned with the procedural intention.

[9] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.463, sim=0.5927)
[CR CR0726r1 for 38.463] Reason for change: In R3-204502, the resource status report related procedures were introduced, but the Assigned Criticality of the Registration Request IE and Reporting Periodicity IE were not aligned in tabular and asn.1. Considering of the functionality, and aligned with XnAP and F1AP, it is better to use criticality reject for the Registration Request IE, and use criticality ignore for the Reporting Periodicity IE. It is also noticed that the Report Characteristics IE was defined as Size 32 in the tabular but 36 in the asn.1. Although in XnAP and F1AP the similar IE is defined as size 32, considering of backward compatibility, it is better to change the tabular to align with asn.1. Summary of change: In the tabular, change the Assigned Criticality of the Regist

[10] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.473, sim=0.5912)
[CR CR1303r1 for 38.473] Reason for change: 1. “RRC multicast MTCH neighbour cell information” IE and/or the “threshold index” IE could be updated by both Session associated message and common message. 2. The value range of the “threshold index” IE is wrong. 3. “Multicast Common CU2DU Cell Information” in Section 9.3.1.314 is defined as a CHOICE type in the tabular, but not in the ASN.1. 4. Transaction ID IE is missing in all the messages of the Multicast Common Configuration procedure(Merged from R3-240262). Summary of change: 1. To remove the “RRC multicast MTCH neighbour cell information” IE and/or the “threshold index” IE from “9.3.1.310 Multicast CU to DU RRC Information”. 2. To modify the upper bound of the “threshold index” IE from “maxnoofThresholdMBS” toward “maxnoofThresholdMBS-1
